capabilities: Chat with AI in the sidebar
Attach notes, text files, and images
Read and edit notes with permission prompts
Track tasks, reasoning, and subagent sessions
Choose models and modes, manage history, and export conversations
extras: Requires opencode to be installed and configured; starts the local executable with the vault as its working directory and OS account permissions. Enabling note-assistant instructions writes a section to the vault's AGENTS.md.
intentEvidence: Originally forked from obsidian-yolo. OpenYOLO is now developed independently and does not maintain upstream compatibility.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an opencode agent that can read and edit vault notes while showing tool actions and permission requests.

relations.evidence: It connects to a local opencode backend through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).

summary: Sidebar AI chat client that connects to a local opencode backend over ACP to discuss, edit, and organize notes with permission prompts.
